titleEn: Decrypt String from Alphabet to Integer Mapping
title: 解码字母到整数映射
summary: 编码中 1 到 9 映射 a 到 i，10# 到 26# 映射 j 到 z，返回解码字符串。
insight: 从左向右看当前后两位后是否紧跟井号；若是就取两位数字，否则取一位数字，再映射为 a+value-1。
pitfalls: 井号只跟在两位数字后
读取两位时指针前进三格

solutions.title: 前瞻令牌解码
solutions.idea: 按一位或带井号两位令牌逐个解析。
steps: 若 i+2<len 且 s[i+2]==#，value=两位数并 i+=3；否则 value=单数字并 i++
追加字符 a+value-1，扫描结束返回

code.java: class Solution { public String freqAlphabets(String s){StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(int i=0;i<s.length();){int value;if(i+2<s.length()&&s.charAt(i+2)=='#'){value=(s.charAt(i)-'0')*10+s.charAt(i+1)-'0';i+=3;}else{value=s.charAt(i)-'0';i++;}answer.append((char)('a'+value-1));}return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun freqAlphabets(s:String):String{val answer=StringBuilder();var i=0;while(i<s.length){val value=if(i+2<s.length&&s[i+2]=='#'){val number=(s[i]-'0')*10+(s[i+1]-'0');i+=3;number}else{s[i++]-'0'};answer.append(('a'.code+value-1).toChar())};return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string freqAlphabets(string s){string answer;for(int i=0;i<(int)s.size();){int value;if(i+2<(int)s.size()&&s[i+2]=='#'){value=(s[i]-'0')*10+s[i+1]-'0';i+=3;}else value=s[i++]-'0';answer+=char('a'+value-1);}return answer;} };
